receptor_policy: Copy exact receptor.pdb bytes and preserve every source chain; keep observed protein_atom_map separate from repair modeled_atom_map. Audit actual CNS heavy inventory, atom names and coordinates; any missing or built protein heavy atoms is a preparation difference and prevents claiming exact matched receptor input.
ligand_policy: Same frozen v3 independent full parent, CCD-named heavy atoms, chain L (fail if receptor already uses L). Rigid translation only: min ligand x = max receptor x +50A, y/z unchanged; translate all hydrogens consistently in the provenance SDF. Prevent unintended distance-detected protein-glycan covalent topology. Do not embed, optimize or use native ligand coordinates.
actual_workflow: topoaa only, debug=true, clean=false, ncores=1, sequential12jobs; no rigidbody/flexref/accuracy stages or AIRs.
glycan_gate: All previously frozen complete-heavy-graph, charge, no-heavy-autobuild, namedstereo and chemicalidealring gates from benchmarks/haddock_prospective_policy.json apply after translation.
